return demonstration is needed right before discharge. The nurse should educate according to the learning style of 
the client and should include the caretakers who will be assisting the client once home (Morris, 2022). 
Client teaching should always include nutritionally related teaching strategies. Too often at discharge, the nurse 
focuses on the physical problem exclusively. Nutritional client education that focuses on the musculoskeletal and 
integumentary system is a more holistic approach to treatment. See Table 19.8 for important nutritional teaching 
concerning both the integumentary and musculoskeletal systems.
